scientific_question: Which Liu behavioral phenomena are reproduced by the frozen v2.4 computational model, which are only qualitatively reproduced with quantitative mismatch, and which are not reproduced?

scope.human_role: The 77-person combined Liu behavioral benchmark defines the phenomenon reference, not a claim that the model is the human brain mechanism.
scope.model_condition: Use dual_access_matched only from the frozen v2.4 fresh-backbone confirmation seeds 2104 and 2105.
scope.network_independence: Compute and classify every row independently in both networks. Never pool virtual participants or bootstrap across networks.
scope.read_only: Load only registered result and human source artifacts. Do not load a checkpoint, train, adapt, resample model choices, change temperature, or recompute Liu policy outputs.
scope.no_tuning: A mismatch is reported and cannot authorize parameter, comparator, evidence-admission, activation, or policy calibration.

bootstrap.unit: participant within the human cohort or virtual participant within one network

status_rules.reproduced: The row's qualitative rule and quantitative calibration rule both pass independently in seeds 2104 and 2105.
status_rules.qualitatively_reproduced_quantitatively_: The qualitative rule passes independently in both networks, but the calibration rule fails in at least one network.
status_rules.not_reproduced: The qualitative rule fails in at least one network.
status_rules.human_interval_membership: Inclusive membership of the model point estimate in the registered human participant-bootstrap 95 percent interval.
status_rules.no_cross_network_rescue: A strong result in one network cannot compensate for failure in the other.

rows.human_estimand: Combined mean accuracy over the eight directly learned pairs and its existing participant-bootstrap 95 percent interval.
rows.model_estimand: dual_access_matched summary learned_accuracy and existing participant bootstrap within each network.
rows.qualitative_rule: Model point estimate is greater than 0.5.
rows.calibration_rule: Model point estimate is inside the existing human 95 percent interval.

rows.human_estimand: Combined mean accuracy over the twenty nonlearned pairs and its existing participant-bootstrap 95 percent interval.
rows.model_estimand: dual_access_matched summary nonlearned_accuracy and existing participant bootstrap within each network.
rows.qualitative_rule: Model point estimate is greater than 0.5.
rows.calibration_rule: Model point estimate is inside the existing human 95 percent interval.

rows.human_estimand: Existing participant mean OLS slope of seven distance-level accuracies and its participant-bootstrap 95 percent interval.
rows.model_estimand: Existing dual_access_matched symbolic_distance_slope within each network.
rows.qualitative_rule: Slope is positive with existing two-sided p_vs_zero below 0.05.
rows.calibration_rule: Model slope is inside the existing human 95 percent interval.

rows.human_estimand: For each eligible participant, average pair accuracy over the seven pairs incident on each true rank position. The registered endpoint contrast is mean(position 1, position 8) minus mean(positions 2 through 7), with a participant-bootstrap 95 percent interval.
rows.model_estimand: Reassemble the same eight-position profile from the 28 frozen dual_access_matched pair mean accuracies. No participant-level model serial-position uncertainty is reconstructible from the frozen artifact and none may be manufactured by replay.
rows.qualitative_rule: Both endpoint accuracies separately exceed the mean accuracy of positions 2 through 7.
rows.calibration_rule: The model mean-endpoint contrast is inside the human participant-bootstrap 95 percent interval.
rows.secondary: Report overall, learned-only, and nonlearned-only position profiles without adding gates.

rows.human_estimand: Published Figure 2d class counts: 15 bimodal and 13 high-accuracy pairs, with no ordinary-unimodal or low-accuracy pair.
rows.model_estimand: Existing dual_access_matched beta_pair_class_counts_analysis within each network.
rows.qualitative_rule: At least 15 of 28 pairs are bimodal and neither ordinary_unimodal nor low_accuracy occurs.
rows.calibration_rule: The qualitative rule is the frozen phenomenon boundary; exact equality to 15 is descriptive, not an additional gate.

rows.human_estimand: Existing analysis-cohort prevalence of at least one pair with error on at least 80 percent of trials and its participant-bootstrap 95 percent interval.
rows.model_estimand: dual_access_matched stable_error_subject_prevalence[80].analysis within each network, with participant bootstrap recomputed only from stored subject records.
rows.calibration_rule: Model point estimate is inside the existing human 95 percent interval.

rows.human_estimand: Existing eligible-cohort proportions self_consistent_incorrect and self_inconsistent, each with a participant-bootstrap 95 percent interval.
rows.model_estimand: Stored dual_access_matched ranking classes divided by 77 eligible virtual participants within each network, with participant bootstrap.
rows.calibration_rule: Both model category proportions are inside their corresponding human 95 percent intervals.

rows.human_estimand: Existing correct-ranker proportion and its participant-bootstrap 95 percent interval; all stored subjective orders must be complete HodgeRank permutations.
rows.model_estimand: Stored dual_access_matched correct ranking class divided by 77 and every stored subjective_order_high_to_low within each network.
rows.qualitative_rule: Every stored Hodge order is a permutation of items 0 through 7 and fewer than half of eligible subjects are correct rankers.
rows.calibration_rule: Model correct-ranker proportion is inside the existing human 95 percent interval.

rows.human_estimand: Mean pairwise Kendall tau among eligible non-correct Hodge rankings, with participant bootstrap recomputed from registered human trials.
rows.model_estimand: Existing dual_access_matched mean_inter_subject_kendall_tau and participant bootstrap recomputed from stored eligible non-correct subjective orders within each network.
rows.qualitative_rule: Mean pairwise Kendall tau is below 0.80, rejecting near-convergence to one common ranking as the reproduced pattern.
rows.calibration_rule: Model point estimate is inside the registered human participant-bootstrap 95 percent interval.

integrity_gates.source_hashes: Every registered source hash must match before any value is read.
integrity_gates.model_identity: The v2.4 result must pass its own source and artifact validation, contain exactly seeds 2104 and 2105, and report fresh_backbone_confirmation_pass.
integrity_gates.condition_identity: dual_access_matched must exist in both seeds and contain 77 eligible subjects with no below-chance exclusion.
integrity_gates.human_identity: Human benchmark status must be source_recomputed_and_paper_checks_reproduced with 77 eligible combined subjects and zero below-chance exclusions.
integrity_gates.finite: Every computed point, interval, and profile value must be finite.
integrity_gates.immutable_output: Serialize with allow_nan false and exclusive creation.

outcome_contract.interpretation: This map evaluates model reproduction of human-inspired phenomena. It is neither a model-selection objective nor evidence that the model mechanism is implemented in the human brain.
outcome_contract.next_step: After the read-only map is frozen, build the main P_T/L_T causal mechanism figure and reduced algorithm from already confirmed links; do not tune v2.4 to repair mismatched rows.
